N.promptText: [S1] At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text. Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.

lines.text: Nobody had ever opened the vault in Safecracker. Not one player. Ever.
lines.cap: Nobody had ever opened *the vault* in Safecracker. Not one player. *Ever.*

lines.text: Until two kids found a way in.
lines.cap: Until two kids found *a way in.*

lines.text: Jay would go inside. His best friend Maya would run the cameras, from her house.
lines.cap: Jay would go inside. His best friend *Maya* would run the cameras, from her house.

lines.text: Ninety seconds on the clock. One guard. One flashlight.
lines.cap: *Ninety seconds* on the clock. One guard. One *flashlight.*

lines.text: Sneak past him, or wait? Comment it.
Then the lasers. They moved every three seconds.
lines.cap: Then *the lasers.* They moved every three seconds.

lines.text: Maya counted him through. Three... two... go!
lines.cap: Maya counted him through. Three... two... *GO!*

lines.text: She froze the cameras. Twenty seconds. That was all they had.
lines.cap: She *froze the cameras.* Twenty seconds. That was all they had.

lines.text: The vault. Three numbers. One wrong click, and every alarm in the building goes off.
lines.cap: *The vault.* Three numbers. One wrong click, and every alarm in the building goes off.

lines.text: Could you crack it? Comment yes or no.
lines.cap: Could you *crack it?* Comment yes or no.

lines.text: The door swung open... and it was full of gold.
lines.cap: The door swung open... and it was full of *gold.*

lines.text: Then every alarm in the building went off.
lines.cap: Then every *alarm* in the building went off.

lines.text: Ten seconds. Two doors. One way out... and one trap.
lines.cap: *Ten seconds.* Two doors. One way out... and *one trap.*

lines.text: Even Maya didn't know which was which.
lines.cap: Even Maya didn't know *which was which.*

lines.text: Red door, or blue door? Comment it.
Safecracker is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.cap: *Safecracker* is one of *tons* of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.

lines.text: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer.
lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer.*
